COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
C482 No.765 of 2023
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Bharat Chaudhary, Advocate for the 
applicant.
Mr. Atul Kumar Shah, Deputy Advocate 
General assisted by Mrs. Mamta Joshi, Brief Holder 
for the State.
It is contended by the applicant that she is not 
even remotely related to the 
complainant/respondent no.2 or her husband nor 
she is their relative and still the proceedings of 
Criminal Case No.42 of 2023, State vs. Rahul 
Khurana and others, had been drawn against the 
present applicant under Sections 323, 504, 506 and 
498-A of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition 
Act, on which the cognizance have been taken by
the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, 
Rishikesh, District Dehradun by issuing the 
summoning order as against the present applicant 
on 19.01.2023.
It is argued, that no offence could be made 
out against the present applicant as she is not 
related to the complainant.
Issue notice to respondent no.2.
Steps to serve respondent no.2 will be taken 
by the applicants within a period of one week from 
today. 
List on 07.06.2023. 
Till the next date of listing the proceedings of 
Criminal Case No.42 of 2023 State vs. Rahul 
Khurana and others pending consideration before 
the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, 
Rishikesh, District Dehradun qua the present 
applicant only would be kept in abeyance.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 25.04.2023
Arti

21.12.2023 C482 No. 1929 of 2023
With
C482 No. 765 of 2023
C482 No. 1969 of 2023
Sri Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Bharat Chaudhary, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mr. M.A. Khan, learned A.G.A. assisted by Ms. 
Meenakshi Sharma, learned Brief Holder for the State￾respondent no.1.
3. Mr. Rohit Kumar Gaur, learned counsel for 
respondent no.2.
4. The applicant- husband of respondent no.2, who 
is present in Court, assures this Court that he will 
regularly pay a sum Rs.10,000/- per month to 
respondent no.2. He also undertakes before this Court 
that by 5th of every month, he will credit the amount 
of Rs.10,000/- in the bank account of respondent 
no.2- wife.
5. Today, the applicant submits that he is ready to 
transfer a sum of Rs.10,000/- in the Google Pay 
account of the brother of respondent no.2, namely, Mr. 
Abhishek Chawla. The applicant and respondent no.2 
submit that they will exchange their mobile numbers 
today itself.
6. Apart from this, learned counsel for respondent 
no.2 prays for and is granted three weeks’ time to file 
the counter-affidavit.
7. Let the counter-affidavit be filed within three 
weeks. 8. List this matter after six weeks.
9. Interim order is extended till the next date of 
listing.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 21.12.2023
NISHANT
